en: Black‑and‑white historic harbor view with multiple steamships and small boats moored along a busy quay. Crates and cargo are stacked on the waterfront and many people are walking or working on the pier. Across the water stands a row of substantial 19th‑century stone buildings; one large, palace‑like block with arcaded ground floor dominates the right side, and a domed church or public building rises in the distant background. A bridge spans the water to the right. Some ship names are visible on the hulls.
